sources.title: allenai/olmo-3-7b-think • LM Studio
sources.snippet: Olmo3 7B Think by AllenAI AllenAI introduces Olmo 3, a new family of 7B and 32B models. This suite includes Base, Instruct, and Think variants. The Base models were trained using a staged training approach. Olmo is a series of Open language models designed to enable the science of language models. These models are trained on the Dolma 3 dataset.
